result.title: From Retrieval to Recognition:Knowledge-Enhanced Post-training of Time Series Foundation Models for Classification
result.summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved notable progress in classification tasks through large-scale pretraining. However, their post-training practice mainly focuses on implicit parameter fine-tuning, where task-relevant information is entangled with abundant irrelevant knowledge in vast parameter spaces. This may hinder TSFMs from precisely activating useful knowledge for downstream classification. To this end, we propose Retrieval-to-Recognition (R2R), a plug-and-play post-training paradigm that adapts pretrained TSFMs to time series classification. Rather than pretraining a new foundation model, R2R improves how existing TSFMs are post-trained: it introduces a decoupled query encoder to extract discriminative patterns and retrieve instance-level numerical knowledge from a constructed knowledge base. The retrieved explicit knowledge is then fused with the TSFM's implicit parametric embeddings, enabling joint knowledge transfer at both the parameter and feature levels. In this way, R2R allows TSFMs to recall task-relevant patterns learned during pretraining, improving the efficiency of knowledge utilization in downstream classification transfer. Experiments on 158 time series datasets show that R2R consistently improves the classification performance of state-of-the-art TSFMs. Ablation and knowledge-enhanced studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Retrieval-to-Recognition（R2R），一种面向时间序列基础模型分类的即插即用后训练范式：用解耦的 query encoder 从知识库中检索实例级数值知识，并与模型参数化隐式嵌入融合，实现参数级与特征级的联合知识迁移，在 158 个数据集上提升分类性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「检索显式知识并与参数化隐式表示融合」的机制可供核查：这种外部证据与内部状态的对齐注入方式，或可类比 LVR 中视觉证据的筛选与写入 latent 状态，但领域为时间序列，迁移可行性需自行判断。
